We believe that AI, when used properly, can have a large positive impact on education, but the major AIs are not built for learning out-of-the-box. We wanted to make sure we gave control to educators so they can make choices. 

(Yes, it is named after the Primer from Diamond Age)

We worked with teachers to help build this initial version. It is neutral as to the models or technologies, so adapt it as needed.

And the last appendix is a prompt that hands the paper to an AI agent and tells it to go build its own version of Primer. It is a paper you can run.

🚨 Our Generative AI Lab is releasing Primer: an agent-driven system where a teacher talks through lessons & gets back a playable simulation for their students, grounded in pedagogy.
